text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Seeking the Pearl
and I ended up getting some Hachimi drinks.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, it goes down so easily!
It feels very gentle on the throat.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And it's packed with nutrients, right?
It's got considerable potential...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should try putting it in miso soup?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's right! A dream superfood combining an abundance of nutritious ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm sure it'll become an indispensable companion for your races and training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We immediately try mixing miso soup and the Hachimi Drink.
The two of us taste-tested it, but—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"BAAAAD!!
The sweet and salty flavors are completely at war!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It looks like simply mixing them together won't work.
...In that case, let's borrow the power of a machine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That spin... yeah, looks like I can handle it.
Let's ride the teacups, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Using the centrifugal force of the spinning teacups, I'll fuse Hachimi and miso soup on a microscopic level!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Spin it faster and faster! Go, go, go, gooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Such intense spinning like I've never experienced before...!
If it's mixed this thoroughly, there's a chance it might turn out delicious—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"BAAA---AAAD!!
This is worse than just mixing them normally!?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It feels like the sweetness and the saltiness are teaming up just to harass my tongue...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can make a habit of drinking something that tastes like this.
Let's find a way to make it more delicious!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Chilling it with ice to sharpen the flavor instead—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Harmonizing it with the astringency of tea...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—However, no matter what we tried, it still tasted awful.
Making a delicious "Hachimi Miso Soup"
seemed like it was going to be quite a challenge...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The nutritional value is ideal.
It's a dream superfood with the potential
to support my very existence.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...The reason it doesn't taste good is surely
because I'm still inexperienced. I lack both skill and knowledge."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then, we have no choice but to learn.
Without a deep understanding of miso soup, we cannot move forward.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm going to go train at a traditional Japanese restaurant!
In order to perfect my Hachimi Miso Soup...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stop Seeking the Pearl just as she's about to dash off.
She seems to be in quite a pinch.
choice_data_list: At times like this, let's drink some miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right.
Let's relax first, then figure out our next move.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *Sluuuuuurp*...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It really is delicious.
A world of difference compared to after adding Hachimi Drink.
choice_data_list: They taste so good when you drink them separately, though.
They taste so good when you drink them separately, though.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heheh, true. If you drink them separately, they don't clash at all—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wait a second!
So as long as they don't meet in my mouth, it's fine?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even though I just drank miso soup, it's not unpleasant at all! And yet, the nutrients from both are being absorbed...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...I've got it! The answer is food pairing!
There was no need to force them together!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I was so focused on perfecting the Hachimi miso soup that I overlooked something so simple...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Which means—our possibilities will expand even more!?
Trainer, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Look! The ingredients are sparkling like gems!
When it comes to flavor pairings, any of them
holds the potential to make a stellar combination with miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For example—how about the curry over there?!
A combination of miso soup and turmeric boosts circulation and warms you right up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Apple pie sounds wonderful for dessert!
It'll provide plenty of vitamins—
an ideal combination!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Stopping opened up such a whole new world! It's all thanks to you stopping me!
choice_data_list: I should recommend this to other people too!
Looks like we'll need to do some more research.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Stopping opened up such a whole new world! It's all thanks to you stopping me!
choice_data_list: I should recommend this to other people too!
Looks like we'll need to do some more research.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! To make sure everyone knows about it,
let's promote it on social media!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Haaai, everyone!
Why not brighten up tonight's dinner with some miso soup and apple pie?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Try it out first!
It's the ultimate combination to absorb
all the necessary nutrients at once!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sparked by Seeking the Pearl's promotion, all sorts of food combinations were posted online.
And before long, "#withMisoSoup" went viral!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's do that!
This place is a treasure trove of food. We can try anything!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Vanilla ice cream, for instance, would be nice.
Paired with miso soup, you can expect great recovery from fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The avocado right there helps flush out excess
sodium, so it goes great with miso soup!
Fufu, the possibilities are practically overflowing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering every single possibility,
Seeking the Pearl threw herself into her research!
